Then he would behold His Beloved among the servants who were created for His days and to bow down before Him, in such abasement that the Pen has confessed its inability to describe it, because of what has befallen Him at the hands of these wrongdoers.
:::

### 99

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل یا قوم انّا دعوناکم فی الظّهور الأوّل الی المنظر الأکبر هذا المقام الأطهر و بشّرناکم بأیّام اللّه فلمّا انشقّ السّتر الأعظم و اتی جمال القدم علی سحاب القدر کفرتم بالّذی آمنتم فویل لکم یا معشر المشرکین خافوا من اللّه و لا تدحضوا الحقّ بما عندکم اذا اشرقت علیکم شمس الآیات من افق اصبع ملیک الأسمآء و الصّفات خرّوا بوجوهکم سجّداً للّه ربّ العالمین انّ سجودکم فنآء بابه لیکون خیراً من عبادة الثّقلین و خضوعکم عند ظهوره خیر لکم عمّا خلق فی السّموات و الأرضین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā qawmu innā daʿawnākum fī al-ẓuhūr al-awwal ilā al-manẓar al-akbar, hādhā al-maqām al-aṭhar, wa-bashsharnākum bi-ayyām Allāh. Fa-lammā inshaqqa al-sitru al-aʿẓam wa-atā Jamālu al-Qidam ʿalā saḥāb al-qadar kafartum bi-alladhī āmantum. Fa-waylun lakum yā maʿshara al-mushrikīn. Khāfū min Allāh wa-lā tudḥiḍū al-ḥaqqa bi-mā ʿindakum. Idhā ashraqat ʿalaykum shamsu al-āyāt min ufuq iṣbaʿ malīk al-asmāʾ wa-al-ṣifāt khirrū bi-wujūhikum sujjadan li-llāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Inna sujūdakum fināʾa bābihi la-yakūnu khayran min ʿibādat al-thaqalayn, wa-khuḍūʿukum ʿinda ẓuhūrihi khayrun lakum ʿammā khuliqa fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: People, in the first Revelation We called you to the Most Great Vision, this most pure station, and announced to you the glad tidings of the days of God. Yet when the greatest veil was torn apart and the Ancient Beauty came upon the clouds of destiny, you disbelieved in the One in whom you had believed. Woe to you, you who associate partners with God! Fear God and do not refute the truth with what you possess. When the Sun of the verses shines upon you from the horizon of the finger of the Sovereign of names and attributes, fall on your faces in prostration before God, the Lord of the worlds. Your prostration at the threshold of His gate is indeed better than the worship of both humankind and jinn, and your humility at His appearance is better for you than whatever has been created in the heavens and the earths.
:::

### 100

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل یا قوم اذکّرکم لوجه اللّه و ما ارید منکم جزآء ان اجری الّا علی الله الّذی فطرنی و بعثنی بالحقّ و جعلنی ذکراً للخلائق اجمعین ان اسرعوا الی منظر اللّه و مقرّه و لا تتّبعوا الشّیطان فی انفسکم انّه یأمرکم بالبغی و الفحشآء و یمنعکم عن الصّراط الّذی نصب فی العالم بهذا الأمر المبرم الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā qawmu udhakkirukum li-wajh Allāh wa-mā urīdu minkum jazāʾan. In ajriya illā ʿalā Allāh alladhī faṭaranī wa-baʿathanī bi-al-ḥaqq wa-jaʿalanī dhikran li-l-khalāʾiq ajmaʿīn. In asriʿū ilā manẓar Allāh wa-maqarrihi wa-lā tattabiʿū al-shayṭāna fī anfusikum. Innahu yaʾmurukum bi-al-baghy wa-al-faḥshāʾ wa-yamnaʿukum ʿan al-ṣirāṭ alladhī nuṣiba fī al-ʿālam bi-hādhā al-amr al-mubram al-ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: People, I admonish you for the sake of God and desire no reward from you. My reward rests only with God, who created Me, raised Me up in truth, and made Me a remembrance for all creatures. Hasten to the place of God’s manifestation and His dwelling, and do not follow Satan within yourselves. He commands you to commit injustice and indecency and bars you from the path established in the world through this irrevocable, wise Command.
:::

### 101

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل قد ظهر الشّیطان بشأن ما ظهر شبهه فی الامکان و کذلک ظهر جمال الرّحمن بالطّراز الّذی ما ادرکت مثله عیون الأوّلین قد ارتفع ندآء الرّحمن و عن ورائه ندآء الشّیطان طوبی لمن سمع ندآء اللّه و توجّه الی جهة العرش منظر قدس کریم من کان فی قلبه اقلّ من خردل حبّ دونی لن یقدر ان یدخل ملکوتی و برهانی ما طرّز به دیباج کتاب الوجود ان انتم من العارفین قل الیوم یوم فیه ظهر الفضل الأعظم و لم یکن شیء لا فی السّموات العلی و لا فی الأراضی السّفلی الّا و ینطقنّ بذکری و یغرّدنّ بثنآء نفسی ان انتم من السّامعین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul qad ẓahara al-shayṭānu bi-shaʾnin mā ẓahara shibhuhu fī al-imkān, wa-kadhālika ẓahara Jamālu al-Raḥmān bi-al-ṭirāz alladhī mā adrakat mithlahu ʿuyūnu al-awwalīn. Qad irtafaʿa nidāʾu al-Raḥmān wa-ʿan warāʾihi nidāʾu al-shayṭān. Ṭūbā li-man samiʿa nidāʾa Allāh wa-tawajjaha ilā jihat al-ʿarsh, manẓari qudsin karīm. Man kāna fī qalbihi aqallu min khardalin ḥubbu dūnī lan yaqdira an yadkhula malakūtī, wa-burhānī mā ṭurriza bihi dībāju kitāb al-wujūd, in antum min al-ʿārifīn. Qul al-yawmu yawmun fīhi ẓahara al-faḍlu al-aʿẓam wa-lam yakun shayʾun lā fī al-samāwāt al-ʿulā wa-lā fī al-arāḍī al-suflā illā wa-yanṭiqanna bi-dhikrī wa-yugharridanna bi-thanāʾ nafsī, in antum min al-sāmiʿīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: Satan has appeared in a manner whose like has never appeared in the realm of existence. Likewise, the Beauty of the All-Merciful has appeared in an adornment the like of which the eyes of earlier generations have never beheld. The call of the All-Merciful has been raised, and behind it the call of Satan. Blessed is whoever has heard the call of God and turned toward the Throne, a noble seat of holiness. Anyone whose heart contains even less than a mustard seed of love for anyone other than Me will never be able to enter My Kingdom. My proof is that with which the brocade of the Book of Existence has been embroidered, if you are among those who understand. Say: Today is the day when the greatest grace has appeared, and there is nothing, either in the heavens above or in the earths below, that does not speak My remembrance and sing My praise, if you are among those who hear.
:::

### 102

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ان یا هیکل الظّهور ان انفخ فی الصّور باسمی ثمّ ان یا هیکل الأسرار تنفّس فی المزمار بذکر ربّک المختار ثمّ ان یا حوریّة الفردوس ان اخرجی من غرف الجنان ثمّ اخبری اهل الأکوان تاللّه قد ظهر محبوب العالمین و مقصود العارفین و معبود من فی السّموات و الأرضین و مسجود الأوّلین و الآخرین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In yā haykala al-ẓuhūr, in unfukh fī al-ṣūr bi-ismī. Thumma in yā haykala al-asrār, tanaffas fī al-mizmār bi-dhikri rabbika al-Mukhtār. Thumma in yā ḥūriyyata al-Firdaws, in ukhrujī min ghuraf al-jinān thumma akhbirī ahla al-akwān: ta-Allāhi qad ẓahara maḥbūbu al-ʿālamīn wa-maqṣūdu al-ʿārifīn wa-maʿbūdu man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn wa-masjūdu al-awwalīn wa-al-ākhirīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Temple of Revelation, blow the trumpet in My name. Then, Temple of Mysteries, breathe into the flute in remembrance of your Lord, the Chosen One. Then, Maiden of Paradise, come out from the chambers of the gardens and announce to the inhabitants of all realms: “By God, the Beloved of the worlds has appeared, the One sought by those who recognize Him, the One worshipped by all who are in the heavens and the earths, before whom the first and the last bow down.”
:::

### 103

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ایّاکم ان تتوقّفوا فی هذا الجمال بعد الّذی ظهر بسلطان القدرة و القوّة و الاستجلال انّه لهو الحقّ و ما سواه معدوم عند احد من عباده و مفقود لدی ظهور انواره ان اسرعوا الی کوثر الفضل و لا تکوننّ من الصّابرین و من توقّف اقلّ من آن لیحبط اللّه عمله و یرجعه الی مقرّ القهر فبئس مثوی المتوقّفین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Iyyākum an tatawaqqafū fī hādhā al-jamāl baʿda alladhī ẓahara bi-sulṭān al-qudra wa-al-quwwa wa-al-istijlāl. Innahu la-huwa al-Ḥaqq wa-mā siwāhu maʿdūmun ʿinda aḥadin min ʿibādihi wa-mafqūdun ladā ẓuhūr anwārihi. In asriʿū ilā kawthar al-faḍl wa-lā takūnanna min al-ṣābirīn. Wa-man tawaqqafa aqalla min ānin la-yuḥbiṭi Allāhu ʿamalahu wa-yurjiʿhu ilā maqarri al-qahr, fa-biʾsa mathwā al-mutawaqqifīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Beware of hesitating over this Beauty after He has appeared with the sovereignty of might, power, and majesty. He is indeed the Truth, and everything besides Him is as nothing before even one of His servants and vanishes at the appearance of His lights. Hasten to the river of grace and do not be among those who wait. Whoever hesitates for less than a moment, God will surely nullify his deeds and return him to the abode of wrath. How wretched is the dwelling of those who hesitate!
:::
